page.layout: One page of running text. Running head at top, page number at top left. No marginal notes. A printer's ornament sits at the end of line 2. Catchword "Quid" at bottom right.

main_text.l: quo minus erit vacui, quiq; melius est compactus.
2. Eadem incommoda sequuntur ex hac opinio-
ne, quæ ex præcedenti in Timæo relata, imò et alia
plura, quæ omnia recensere minime opus est.
3. Errarunt postremo & illi, qui leuitate & gra-
uitatem æstimari voluerunt, primùm quidè ex ma-
gnitudine & paruitate, deinde vero etiam ex mate-
ria, siue omnia essent composita ex una materia, si-
ue ex materijs contrarijs. Facile autem est hanc opi-
nionem euertere. Primùm ex ijs quæ dicta sunt, ma-
nifestum est, imò & experientia comprobat, non sta-
tim, quorum magna est moles, ea grauiora his esse
quæ sunt parua mole. Magnus ignis non est grauior
modica terra. Deinde si una constituatur omnium
materia, nihil erit simpliciter leue, nihil item simpli-
citer graue: sed tantùm dicetur aliquid leue vel gra-
ue ad aliud: quinetiam una tantùm erit motus spe-
cies, qua nimirum omnia necessariò feruntur aut sur-
sum, aut deorsum: atq; ita tolletur aut omnis graui-
tas, aut omnis leuitas. Quòd si contrariæ ponuntur
materiæ, tum non erunt graue aut leue nisi simpli-
citer: atque omnia medio modo se habentia nega-
buntur.
Cæterùm ut plenius natura grauitatis ac leuita-
tis, præterea quomodo in elementis hæc consideren-
tur, perspectum fiat, paulo accuratius sunt
quædam exploranda.

page.notes: The ornament at the end of line 2 is a printer's fleuron, not a note. The page number "242" is partly obscured; the last digit is doubtful. The running head reads "AND. HYPERII" with the rest of the title cut off at the edge, so it may be incomplete. Printed "Q" in "Quòd" is decorated. Words broken at line ends keep their printed hyphens. Long s is written as plain s throughout.
